newsitem.title: USA: Coventry gains $3 mln in Pittsburgh deal.
newsitem.headline: Coventry gains $3 mln in Pittsburgh deal.

text.p: Coventry Corp said Friday it will record an after tax gain of $3 million following the closing of a transaction with Allegheny Health, Education and Research Foundation (AHERF).

The company had previously said that AHERF would acquire its medical practices located throughout metropolitan Pittsburgh. Under the terms of the transaction, AHERF and HealthAmerica -- Coventry's health plan in PIttsburgh -- entered into a long-term agreement for provision of health care services.
Allegheny Health, Education and Research Foundation (AHERF) is a statewide, 2,650-bed academic health center located in Pennsylvania.
Coventry Corporation, headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, is a managed health care company.
